name: Shelley Boyle
office: City of San Marino, Member of the City Council

items.text: Shelley Boyle says she has served on the San Marino Planning Commission for eight years. She is the co-executive director of Young & Healthy, a Pasadena nonprofit connecting children and families to health care.
